msdfgen v1.13.1 (tag), https://github.com/Chlumsky/msdfgen
commit ec84cd53590bb114c5a7fa4fe7be5adafec6276a
MIT licence (LICENSE.txt), Copyright (c) 2014 - 2026 Viktor Chlumsky.

Only the core library is vendored (core/, msdfgen.h, LICENSE.txt), unchanged: the
extensions (FreeType, Skia, SVG import), the command-line tool, the CMake files and
the other directories are left out. The glyph outlines come from stb_truetype
(pc/src/ui_msdf.cpp turns them into a msdfgen shape); the core is compiled into
the game as C++ with -DMSDFGEN_PUBLIC= (pc/tools/build_boot.py).
